subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61564eb632b27341ed1c836fcffad50265eae576109e89a62ff10abed5fc7e21.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Center element → The number of lines is increasing subsequently.

2) First box series → The elements at the corners interchange positions diagonally.

3) Second box series → The elements at the corners shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d83f007170f327d9c1a405aa720e7a5861f3b665d51897480d59e5f670b6bb23.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3e69b3187856fd8db53d22a4f10e3df246dc7345488a9b67109e90bfab592a1.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
